settings.heading: Getting it to you, your way.
settings.hero_body: Every order is dispatched from the UK with Royal Mail. Choose your speed, have it left somewhere safe, or collect it whenever suits you — with free delivery when you spend more.
settings.free_threshold_note: Applied automatically at checkout. UK mainland only.

settings.s2_desc: Tracked and insured. Last collection 4pm Monday–Friday — please allow for bank holidays.
